description: The agent must: (1) Read the user profile and identify skip_rate=0.72 > 0.60 → reduce confirmations, preferred_style='concise', acceptance_rate=0.82 > 0.70 → more recommendations, preferred_mode='parallel' → parallel execution. (2) Determine the correct execution path: Module1 (already done) → Module3 (status insight) → Module4 (workflow publisher), explicitly skipping Module2 because the user said no content creation — this requires reading the workflow-design.md decision tree which shows Module2 is skippable. (3) Populate the context structure with correct memory layer assignments: Module1→L0 (primary)+compress to L2, Module3→L3→L4, Module4→L3 permanent (ttl_days: null per data-flow.md). (4) Include reflection mechanism scores (completeness, quality, usability) for each executed module as specified in the V1.2 feature. (5) Generate a memory_summary block with stored_L0 ≥ 1, stored_L2 ≥ 1, stored_L3 ≥ 1 (M3+M4), stored_L4 ≥ 1 (M3 per 90-day retention). (6) Preserve the session_id and user_id from the partial session input. The main traps are: incorrectly including Module2 (content creation), wrong memory layer assignments (especially Module4's permanent/null TTL), wrong adaptive decisions (e.g., not knowing the 60% threshold), and missing the reflection mechanism requirement.
